title: 27 June 2013: Paul McCartney live at Ernst-Happel-Stadion, Vienna, Austria
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Ernst-Happel-Stadion in Vienna, Austria, on 27 June 2013.

It was the 16th show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015.

Paul plays in Vienna tonight. Fans going to the gig can also check out Linda's exhibition at Kunst Haus Wien: http://t.co/pGYm5N7moF

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) June 27, 2013

It was the final date of the European leg of the tour, before the group began the second set of North American dates.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

"Vienna, we have come to rock you" PM

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) June 27, 2013


https://instagram.com/p/bEW2spO6Nx/

vienna was a gas! now enjoying a nice little break at home before we hit ottawa. ahhh yeah.

— Rusty Anderson (@rustyanderson1) June 30, 2013
